verification_boundary: Creator-attributed via public X mirror or aggregation; exact original tweet ID, direct image/GIF bytes and original prompts remain missing for some examples.
prompt_policy: Editorial paraphrases written for evaluation, not creator's exact original prompts or claims of executions.

title.zh: 日本商店街熟食店写实对照

cases.creator: GENEL

prompt_paraphrase.zh: 傍晚的日本街边熟食店；一位年长男店主站在玻璃柜台后，用夹子夹起可乐饼。混合室内荧光灯与夕阳，重点观察皱纹、油炸食品表面以及玻璃反射，照片无字标。
prompt_paraphrase.en: Eye-level documentary photograph of a Japanese neighborhood delicatessen at dusk. An older shopkeeper holds a croquette above a glass case; mixed fluorescent and sunset light reveals skin, fried-food texture and reflections. No added lettering.

cases.claim_note: Creator compares Seedream 5.5, GPT Image 2.6 and Nano Banana 2.1 using one prompt and a single run each; conclusions about the reflection and skin are subjective.
cases.original_prompt_quote: 実写の写真。自然なスナップ写真。35mmレンズ、目の高さから撮る。

title.zh: GTA 风格游戏街景与远处标牌
title.en: GTA-style street scene and distant signage

cases.creator: lyra
cases.images: Creator-posted screenshot is mentioned by social mirrors; image bytes not locally inspected

prompt_paraphrase.zh: 游戏内第三人称街景构图，真实的街道环境和背景店面告示牌，检查远景小字是否出现刻板套话与重复文本。
prompt_paraphrase.en: Cinematic open-world game street scene with believable shops and a legible distant sign. Inspect whether background text remains semantically appropriate rather than generic filler.

cases.claim_note: Pre-release Seedream 5.5 output self-attributed by creator; creator called out an unexpected sign reading 'Good People Brighter Tomorrow'. GTA is the author's style reference, not proof of an official game screenshot.

title.zh: Seedream 与 Nano Banana / GPT Image 三模型对比
title.en: Seedream vs Nano Banana and GPT Image comparison

cases.creator: lyra
cases.images: Source post reportedly has 3 ALT-labeled model images; no image copies

prompt_paraphrase.zh: 同一视觉任务分别用 Seedream 5.5、Nano Banana Pro 和 GPT Image 2.6 生成，观察皮肤细节、物体纹理和整体写实风格；避免从单张作品推断普遍优劣。
prompt_paraphrase.en: Run the same brief separately in Seedream 5.5, Nano Banana Pro and GPT Image 2.6. Compare skin and material detail with each result labeled by model; treat any ranking as subjective.

cases.claim_note: Social post explicitly labels each of three images by model. Prompt parity and model backend have not been independently audited.

title.zh: 四模型人像同提示词盲测
title.en: Four-model portrait test with shared prompt

cases.creator: 94vanai
cases.images: Four images reported: Seedream 5.5, ChatGPT, Gemini and Grok. Source media not archived.

prompt_paraphrase.zh: 在相同写实人像委托下分别用四种图像模型出图，比较脸型多样性、过度磨皮、眼神与微表情、皮肤质感。保留四张结果与生成设置以便盲评。
prompt_paraphrase.en: Apply one realistic portrait brief to four image generators and compare facial diversity, over-smoothing, emotion and texture. Keep the four outputs and settings grouped for a fair evaluation.

cases.claim_note: Author identifies P1 as Seedream 5.5, P2 as ChatGPT, P3 as Gemini and P4 as Grok; the reported strengths and weaknesses are author opinions, not a benchmark.

title.zh: 日系冬日下午人像，5.0 Pro 对比 5.5

cases.creator: TSUBAKI
cases.images: Post presents a creator comparison; a direct photo URL was not confirmed

prompt_paraphrase.zh: 日本冬日午后自然光下的人像，同样的人物与镜头语言分别让 Seedream 5.0 Pro 与 5.5 生成，关注真实皮肤纹理、五官特征与冷暖空气感。
prompt_paraphrase.en: Natural portrait in a Japanese winter afternoon, with the same intended person and scene across Seedream 5.0 Pro and 5.5; evaluate skin detail, facial features and airy daylight.

cases.claim_note: Creator reports improved natural skin texture and atmosphere in Seedream 5.5; original prompt and media file are still missing.

dedup_watchlist.reason: A 100-round +1-second watch edit is also described in the prior research as @UFO2002616's watch comparison, and an official watch demo exists. Treat as possible repost/source mix-up; do not add as new case without original media comparison.
